title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics; parity fixes; bump versions to v1.48.0
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR brings Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs into parity for auth and retry behavior, improves streaming ergonomics across languages, fixes a set of parity regressions, and bumps SDK versions to v1.48.0. Motivation: customers observed inconsistent retry behavior between SDKs (exponential vs fixed backoff), streaming ergonomics differed (callbacks vs async iterators), and small API surface differences cause developer confusion. This change consolidates the retry policy interface, centralizes auth token refresh flow, harmonizes streaming APIs (async iterator + callback adapters), applies parity fixes found in cross-language tests, and updates CHANGELOGs and package versions. - Add unified RetryPolicy abstraction (max_retries, backoff_strategy, jitter) implemented in each SDK with same default semantics. - Centralize auth token refresh to a single helper: single refresh per token lifetime, concurrent-refresh deduping. - Streaming ergonomics: Python & TS support async iterator + on_chunk callback; Go exposes a channel-based iterator and a helper adapter for callback style. - Parity fixes: consistent error classes, identical field names in response wrappers, align default timeouts across SDKs. - Version bumps: python v1.48.0, typescript v1.48.0, go v1.48.0; update package manifests and changelogs. Checklist: - [x] implement RetryPolicy in Python/TS/Go - [x] central auth refresh + tests - [x] streaming ergonomics parity and adapters - [x] update changelogs and package versions - [x] cross-language integration tests green (CI) Notes: Kept changes minimal in each repo: most logic is small, but tests and examples updated to illustrate new ergonomics. No breaking behavior for existing users unless they depended on non-documented retry backoffs (we consider that unlikely).
